nodes.label: frontend/AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-guidance document for the Next.js frontend. Warns that this Next.js version (16.2.6) has breaking changes versus older conventions and instructs agents to read the bundled guides in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. Wrapped in nextjs-agent-rules markers.

nodes.label: frontend/CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code project instructions file for the frontend. A single line '@AGENTS.md' that imports/includes the AGENTS.md agent rules, delegating all frontend agent guidance to that document.

nodes.label: frontend/README.md
nodes.summary: Default Next.js bootstrap README for the frontend app. Sections: Getting Started (dev server commands), Learn More (Next.js docs links), and Deploy on Vercel. Boilerplate onboarding documentation.

nodes.label: frontend/package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for the Next.js frontend (name 'frontend', v0.1.0, private). Scripts: dev (next dev --webpack), build, start, lint (eslint). Dependencies: next 16.2.6, react/react-dom 19.2.4, framer-motion, lucide-react, xlsx. Dev deps: TailwindCSS 4 (@tailwindcss/postcss), TypeScript 5, eslint 9 with eslint-config-next, type packages.

nodes.label: frontend/tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the Next.js frontend. Defines compilerOptions, include and exclude globs for the project's TypeScript compilation and Next.js build.
